experiences.description: Co-founded Goodmellow and now leading operations full-time as COO. Building across functional and hemp-derived beverages in a fast-growing category redefining social drinking.

In this role, I streamline activities of operations & IT while administering the operating budget. Along with directing all facets of operations associated with building security and fraud monitoring protocols for in-store and online, I also supervise the performance of acquisition and launched teams operating in six store acquisitions across California and Colorado. Also, I lead the overall activities of the company’s HQ, CA, and CO fulfillment centers. 

A small selection of my key highlights includes:
• Achieved 10% labor savings through the development and execution of assembly productivity tool.
• Created/managed online sales and fulfillment channels.
• Ensured smooth flow of organizational processes by steering daily activities.
• Improved organizational performance through the establishment and implementation of an operations manual for the entire organization, such as training modules and testing.
• Successfully minimized logistics spending for online shipping by over 12%
• Slashed labor and associated consumables internal product transit system.

My primary duty in this role was to improve the efficiency of all in-store locations by restructuring the POS experience. Also, I led the successful migration of POS from Retail Pro 8 > Retail Pro 9 > LightSpeed for 250+ employees. Moreover, I rendered expert-level support in the building of physical facilities for streamlining distribution and fulfillment centers operations.
Please check some of my accomplishments during this tenure:
• Enhanced effectiveness of inter-store transfers system through establishment and implementation of scalable cycle count process and inventory tracking.

• Optimized organizational performance by drafting assortment plans and deploying ideal mixes and automated allocation strategies.
